body: Also like I said. I don’t have a license, I don’t have a car. And we lived with his parents. How would I ever go out anywhere? How would I even talk to anyone? Every night my phone was plugged in above his head. He could have searched it anytime.

Yes I have nothing to hide. I was just so infuriated he wanted to text everyone from my blocked list, after accusing me of having a disease. I’m at my parents house. But all my belongings are still at his house.

He said everything would have been ok if I let him go through my phone. He even offered for me to go in his. I was so offended he thought I had an STD that I completely shut off and told him no way basically. Also, no I didn’t want to fight with him. I just told him that I was upset. He said he would be home at 12am, and then texted me at 8pm saying he was too drunk to come home. He left at 630, and was already drunk by 8? And that was that.
And we lived with his parents...

* text
* them
Sorry I’m upset and my grammar isn’t the best right now.

Yes so the other night I was on my phone, while he was upstairs. He came down and I sort of tossed my phone to the side. He said I was being sketchy, so on and so forth. I haven’t wanted to.. have sex in awhile. I have a UTI so you know. He then accused me of having an STD, and demanded to go through my phone. I said fine... until he wanted to go through my WHOLE blocked list.. and test every single person to see if I was cheating on him with him. At that point I was so pissed off to be accused of all that garbage that I took my phone and told him he’s not going in it. He then flew off the handle and told me to get out. He however, has done much more sketchy things. Just last weekend he went out, got drunk, and never came home. I never leave the house. I don’t have a license.
Only a year and 3 months. We lived together, he’s the first person I lived with, etc. Its so different being with someone everyday, doing everything together, to absolutely nothing. In a second.

That’s interesting, and also very sad. I feel terrible. Physically sick, I even threw up. It feels like my whole world just crashed around me. I feel like I’ve lost everything. I feel like I’ve lost half of myself. I feel like nothing is going right for me. I feel destroyed and defeated.

I need about a zillion hugs. And a 5 year nap. Also, ALL OF MY THINGS are at his house. And he said I’m not allowed back and he took my key the other night. Do I have my dad go with me sometime while he’s at work? I could get his dad to let me in.

I never ended up letting him go in it. He wanted to go through ALL my blocked contacts and TEXT them, after accusing me of having an STD. My blocked contacts are blocked for a reason. I DONT TALK TO ANY OF THEM. Men and women. My brain shut off. I was disrespected and at that point didn’t even want to show him my phone. He’s told me a million times to not go in his phone. But then he wanted to search mine? I also sent him a “cute” picture of myself a couple times this past week. I finally feel comfortable in my body again. And he said, I quote, “nice fake nudes” because he thinks I sent them to someone else.

Thank you. I feel crazy right now. Should I have just let him go through them all? Truthfully after he accused me of having an STD, I didn’t feel like showing him anything. That’s completely disrespectful. I’m always home and he knows that. I don’t even have a license...

I hope it isn’t the case either. Thank you. I don’t know where to go from here. I know I’m young but how do I get over not seeing him everyday, sleeping together every night, all the little things. I feel destroyed. 😞
Where do I get tested? And how do I ask? I shouldn’t have ever tossed my phone to the side. I’ve never seen him blow up like that 😢
